{{Quote|The station is a fortress. It has more guns than a fleet, and a weapon that will crack open worlds like they were ripe wuli nuts.|Admiral Motti|<ref name="DS" />}}
'''Wuli nuts''' were a type of [[Nut/Legends|nut]] that could be cracked when ripe.<ref name="DS" /> They were used in a variety of [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] to add flavor and texture and were light brown in [[Color/Legends|color]].<ref name="SWG" /> Pulverized wuli nut were an ingredient in the [[Bestine threeberry pie]].<ref name="TOR:PfaD" /> Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">Wuli [[Nut/Legends|nuts]] are mentioned shortly before the [[attack on the first Death Star]], which ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]] compared the ease with which the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] could destroy [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to cracking ripe wuli nuts.<ref name="DS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wuli nuts were first mentioned in the [[2007]] novel [[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']], authored by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]].<ref name="DS" /> They then made a full appearance and were pictured in the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> which closed in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Wuli nuts were added to the game as a [[W:c:swg:Foraged Rare Component|rare foraged food component]] for the [[W:c:swg:Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer (Schematic)|portable deep fryer]],<ref name="SWG" /> introduced with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]],"<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67692&month=042008|text=Weekly Picks – 4/3/08 - 04/03/2008}}</ref> published on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
